panels.title: Service overview · live health, not benchmark accuracy
Model endpoint probe
panels.description: Endpoint reachability only. Does not prove model generation or parsing works.

panels.title: HTTP availability
panels.description: POST redaction: 2xx / (2xx + 5xx). Excludes 4xx. Degraded 200 is available. No traffic is undefined. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Degraded share of successful redactions
panels.description: Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Session capacity used
panels.description: Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Requests by HTTP status
panels.description: POST /v3/redaction only. Includes authentication failures.

panels.title: HTTP end-to-end latency · successful redactions
panels.description: Server entry through final ASGI body send: validation, sessions, pipeline and serialization. Excludes client network time.

panels.title: Pipeline latency · normal / degraded / error
panels.description: Orchestrator only. Independent of HTTP latency; percentile differences are not overhead measurements.

panels.title: Stage latency · p95
panels.description: Last window p95 by stage. Detection stages run concurrently; do not sum stage percentiles.

panels.title: Degraded share · successful responses
panels.description: Only final successful degraded responses. Requests failing after fallback count as errors instead. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Degraded responses by cause and stage
Model final outcomes · selected range
panels.description: One terminal outcome per invocation, after parsing: ok, timeout, unavailable, unparseable, cancelled, internal_error. Queue timeouts count as invocations.

panels.title: Capacity rejections · selected range
panels.description: Only capacity-exhausted; not all HTTP 503 responses. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Components · last observed result
panels.description: Rules and Presidio report last actual execution, not continuous probes. -1 = not observed, 0 = failure, 1 = success.

panels.title: Versions and runtime backends
panels.description: Default model backend is stub. Mixed components still include stub prompts/parsers. Version metadata is not evidence of benchmark accuracy.

panels.title: Diagnostics · expand for model queues, API lifecycle and decisions
Model slot queue wait · p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Includes successful and timed-out queue waits. Separate from execution latency.

panels.title: Model execution and parsing · p50/p95/p99
panels.description: After acquiring the slot through generation and parsing. Queue-only timeouts have no execution sample.

panels.title: In-flight redaction requests
panels.description: Requests admitted to pipeline processing; excludes rejected validation and capacity requests.

panels.title: API lifecycle · selected route and method
panels.description: Use diagnostic filters to inspect redaction, restore and delete independently. Overview metrics remain POST redaction only.

panels.title: HTTP latency · selected operation and status
panels.description: Includes errors and restore/delete; separated by status so fast rejects do not hide slow successful operations.

panels.title: Rendered span decisions · selected range
panels.description: Rendered decisions, including attempts that later fail audit/serialization. Missed entities are absent; this cannot measure leak rate or accuracy.

panels.title: Model calls with valid parsed output
panels.description: Final ok / all terminal outcomes, including queue timeout and cancellation. Not model accuracy. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.
